theorem QOU.Mathlib.Schensted.insertWord_uninsertSteps_of_standard {P Q : List (List ℕ)} (hPs : RowsSorted P) (hPc : ColStrict P) (hPn : NoEmptyRows P) (hQc : ColStrict Q) (hQstrict : ∀ row ∈ Q, List.Sorted (fun (x1 x2 : ℕ) => x1 < x2) row) (hQnd : Q.flatten.Nodup) {n : ℕ} (hrange : ∀ t < n, t ∈ Q.flatten) (hshape : tableauShape P = addCellSteps [] (qPositions Q n)) :
insertWord (uninsertSteps P (qPositions Q n)).2 = P

theorem QOU.Mathlib.Schensted.addableAlong_qPositions {Q : List (List ℕ)} (hcs : ColStrict Q) (hstrict : ∀ row ∈ Q, List.Sorted (fun (x1 x2 : ℕ) => x1 < x2) row) (hnd : Q.flatten.Nodup) (n : ℕ) :
(∀ t < n, t ∈ Q.flatten) → AddableAlong [] (qPositions Q n)

theorem QOU.Mathlib.Schensted.qPositions_succ (Q : List (List ℕ)) (n : ℕ) :
qPositions Q (n + 1) = qPositions Q n ++ [(qRowOf Q n).getD 0]

theorem QOU.Mathlib.Schensted.count_qPositions {Q : List (List ℕ)} (hnd : Q.flatten.Nodup) {k i : ℕ} (hi : i < Q.length) (hrange : ∀ t < k, t ∈ Q.flatten) :
List.count i (qPositions Q k) = countLt (Q.getD i []) k

theorem QOU.Mathlib.Schensted.getD_qRowOf_eq_iff {Q : List (List ℕ)} (hnd : Q.flatten.Nodup) {t i : ℕ} (hi : i < Q.length) (ht : t ∈ Q.flatten) :
(qRowOf Q t).getD 0 = i ↔ t ∈ Q.getD i []

def QOU.Mathlib.Schensted.qPositions (Q : List (List ℕ)) (n : ℕ) :
List ℕ

theorem QOU.Mathlib.Schensted.nodup_of_mem_of_flatten_nodup (Q : List (List ℕ)) :
Q.flatten.Nodup → ∀ row ∈ Q, row.Nodup

theorem QOU.Mathlib.Schensted.qRowOf_eq_some_iff_mem {Q : List (List ℕ)} (hnd : Q.flatten.Nodup) {t i : ℕ} (hi : i < Q.length) :
qRowOf Q t = some i ↔ t ∈ Q.getD i []

theorem QOU.Mathlib.Schensted.qRowOf_eq_some_of_mem (Q : List (List ℕ)) :
Q.flatten.Nodup → ∀ (t i : ℕ), i < Q.length → t ∈ Q.getD i [] → qRowOf Q t = some i

theorem QOU.Mathlib.Schensted.qRowOf_isSome_of_mem_flatten (Q : List (List ℕ)) (t : ℕ) :
t ∈ Q.flatten → ∃ (r : ℕ), qRowOf Q t = some r

theorem QOU.Mathlib.Schensted.countLt_above_qRowOf {Q : List (List ℕ)} (hcs : ColStrict Q) (hstrict : ∀ row ∈ Q, List.Sorted (fun (x1 x2 : ℕ) => x1 < x2) row) {r k : ℕ} (h : qRowOf Q k = some (r + 1)) :
countLt (Q.getD (r + 1) []) k < countLt (Q.getD r []) k

theorem QOU.Mathlib.Schensted.qRowOf_lt_length (Q : List (List ℕ)) (t r : ℕ) :
qRowOf Q t = some r → r < Q.length

theorem QOU.Mathlib.Schensted.mem_of_qRowOf (Q : List (List ℕ)) (t r : ℕ) :
qRowOf Q t = some r → t ∈ Q.getD r []

theorem QOU.Mathlib.Schensted.countLt_above_mem {Q : List (List ℕ)} (hcs : ColStrict Q) (hstrict : ∀ row ∈ Q, List.Sorted (fun (x1 x2 : ℕ) => x1 < x2) row) {r k : ℕ} (hr : r + 1 < Q.length) (hk : k ∈ Q.getD (r + 1) []) :
countLt (Q.getD (r + 1) []) k < countLt (Q.getD r []) k

theorem QOU.Mathlib.Schensted.getD_countLt {row : List ℕ} (hs : List.Sorted (fun (x1 x2 : ℕ) => x1 < x2) row) {k : ℕ} (hk : k ∈ row) :
row.getD (countLt row k) 0 = k

theorem QOU.Mathlib.Schensted.countLt_lt_length {row : List ℕ} (hs : List.Sorted (fun (x1 x2 : ℕ) => x1 < x2) row) {k : ℕ} (hk : k ∈ row) :
countLt row k < row.length

theorem QOU.Mathlib.Schensted.countLt_lt_length_and_getD (row : List ℕ) :
List.Sorted (fun (x1 x2 : ℕ) => x1 < x2) row → ∀ k ∈ row, countLt row k < row.length ∧ row.getD (countLt row k) 0 = k

theorem QOU.Mathlib.Schensted.countLt_eq_zero {row : List ℕ} {k : ℕ} (h : ∀ b ∈ row, k ≤ b) :
countLt row k = 0

theorem QOU.Mathlib.Schensted.countLt_above {Q : List (List ℕ)} (hcs : ColStrict Q) (hstrict : ∀ row ∈ Q, List.Sorted (fun (x1 x2 : ℕ) => x1 < x2) row) {r c : ℕ} (hr : r + 1 < Q.length) (hcc : c < (Q.getD (r + 1) []).length) :
countLt (Q.getD (r + 1) []) ((Q.getD (r + 1) []).getD c 0) < countLt (Q.getD r []) ((Q.getD (r + 1) []).getD c 0)

theorem QOU.Mathlib.Schensted.lt_countLt_of_getD_lt (row : List ℕ) :
List.Sorted (fun (x1 x2 : ℕ) => x1 < x2) row → ∀ (c k : ℕ), c < row.length → row.getD c 0 < k → c < countLt row k

theorem QOU.Mathlib.Schensted.countLt_getD (row : List ℕ) :
List.Sorted (fun (x1 x2 : ℕ) => x1 < x2) row → ∀ c < row.length, countLt row (row.getD c 0) = c

theorem QOU.Mathlib.Schensted.countLt_cons (a : ℕ) (t : List ℕ) (k : ℕ) :
countLt (a :: t) k = countLt t k + if a < k then 1 else 0

theorem QOU.Mathlib.Schensted.countLt_nil (k : ℕ) :
countLt [] k = 0

def QOU.Mathlib.Schensted.countLt (row : List ℕ) (k : ℕ) :
ℕ
